name: Runemaster: Glyph God cuts Glyphic Overload to a 30s cooldown (#1942)
contract: Glyph God 520156 (CharacterAdvancement 29346, class 32 Arcane talent, passive) reads 'Reduces the cooldown of Glyphic Overload by 15 sec.' Its single effect is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -15001 + DieSides 1 = -15000 ms, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 144), which intersects Glyphic Overload 520099 (SpellFamilyName 38, flags (0, 0, 128)) via SpellInfo::IsAffected; 520099 is otherwise a single-rank chain with RecoveryTime 45000. Player::AddSpellCooldown folds SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN natively, so no source file, module or pending SQL references 520156 and none is needed: the talent must turn the 45s cooldown into 30s. The scenario casts Overload once without the talent (control: cooldown reads ~45s, proving the cooldown exists at all), resets it, learns Glyph God, and casts again (discriminating: ~30s; the 20-35s band fails both the unfixed ~42-45s and a zeroed cooldown). Overload costs 40% mana, so mana is refilled from a max_power-proven pool before each cast and every cast asserts cast_failure 0 so an unpaid cast fails loudly as setup, never as a cooldown reading. Overload is self-range, so both casts target the caster.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: mana pool covers the 40% Overload cost
Fill mana for the control cast
CONTROL: Overload enters its native 45s cooldown
SETUP: Glyph God aura is active
Fill mana for the talented cast
DISCRIMINATING: Overload cooldown is cut to 30s
